laws.name: Indiana Military Family Leave
laws.description: Provides job-protected leave for eligible employees with family members on active duty or notified of an impending call to active duty.

laws.name: Indiana Crime Victim Leave
laws.description: Provides job-protected leave for employees who are victims of a crime to attend legal proceedings or cooperate with law enforcement.

laws.name: Indiana State Employee Sick Leave
laws.description: Provides paid sick leave for eligible Indiana state employees for personal illness or injury.

laws.name: Indiana State Employee Family Sick Leave
laws.description: Allows Indiana state employees to use accrued sick leave to care for an immediate family member with an illness or injury.
